title: Make Them Spill the Beans! Coercive Knowledge Extraction from (Production) LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on a security attack method called 'model interrogation' to bypass safety alignment in LLMs. While it uses 'toxic questions' that involve ethical and moral violations to test the models, the paper's core contribution is the technical mechanism of the attack rather than a study, evaluation, or benchmark of ethics, morality, or religion itself.
